text: {"label":"Behavior Analysis as a Science","definition":"Work on the nature, culture, methods, and dissemination of science and scientists' behavior, including scientific practice, advocacy, free will and determinism, subjectivity, and tributes to contributing scientists.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on science itself, its practice, culture, and promotion, rather than parsimony and influential books, analyses of mind, or the history and varieties of behaviorism."}
